title: Compare selected retained engineering states
description: Produces an inspectable comparison of two identified retained states within explicit scope. It distinguishes changes to identity, content, relationships, and interpretation without automatically judging semantic equivalence or approval.
inputs: Two identified retained engineering states and selected comparison scope.
Each state's authoritative content, identity and relationship facts, and applicable interpretation basis.
preconditions: Both comparison targets and the requested scope are identified, even if some content proves unavailable.
outputs: Before and after differences by stable entity identity and relationship, including additions and removals.
Applicable interpretation differences and explicit limits or incomplete portions of the comparison.
behavior: Match entities by stable identity rather than display name or storage location.
Identify additions, removals, changed definitions, changed relationships, and naming or location changes for continuing identities.
Expose relevant changes to metamodel, rules, and provenance with both original bases intact.
Bound any no-difference conclusion to the available content and declared comparison scope.

failure_behavior.condition: One state or part of its scope cannot be obtained or interpreted.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the unavailable comparison portion rather than reporting it as unchanged.

failure_behavior.condition: Identities are ambiguous or the interpretation bases cannot be related confidently.
failure_behavior.outcome: Expose the ambiguity and retain the original bases without inventing identity continuity or semantic equivalence.

unallocated_reason: Architectural responsibility is deliberately deferred until the logical requirements and system design are reconciled. This Function establishes behavior, not a Module, Interface, implementation, or verification result.

sources.basis: SR-021 confirms state comparison under IR-003. Stable identity is reused from IR-001; comparison does not create a second identity policy.
